# place superseded by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/placeSupersededBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

Links a place to the place that replaced it — Constantinople [`placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) Istanbul, a merged municipality [`placeSupersededBy`](gmeow-placeSupersededBy.md) its successor. Directional. The superseded place is retained (never deleted) and may carry [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false.
